name.zh-Hant: 敦克爾克撤退（發電機行動）

profile.theater_area_basis: derived（由 JSON bounds 外框產生，非出處；需考證組以出處重畫）

name.zh-Hant: 發電機行動啟動與走廊作戰

summary.zh-Hant: 5月26日晚下令發動發電機行動，英國遠征軍沿狹窄走廊且戰且退，法軍於27日夜放棄格拉沃利訥退守馬爾迪克—斯皮凱—貝爾格運河線，比利時軍於午夜停火。

citations.quote: By the following Sunday evening, when Operation Dynamo was ordered ...
By midnight on May the 27th the King of the Belgians had accepted defeat and the Belgian Army had been ordered to cease fire.
During the night they withdrew from Gravelines and the Aa and occupied a line which followed canals from Mardick through Spycker to Bergues.

name.zh-Hant: 比軍投降後撤入灘頭陣地

summary.zh-Hant: 比軍投降後東翼洞開，德軍28日上午抵達紐波特一帶周界並奪得一座橋，英軍各師於29至30日陸續撤入敦克爾克周界。

citations.quote: CHAPTER XIII AFTER THE BELGIAN SURRENDER 28th May, 1940
By midday on the 30th practically all our retiring forces were within the perimeter
advanced troops of the enemy reached the perimeter between Nieuport and the sea coast ... capturing and holding an undestroyed bridge and a small bridgehead in the town of Nieuport.

summary.zh-Hant: 英軍第1軍守西半、第2軍守東半周界，德軍31日猛攻紐波特、弗爾訥與 Bulskamp，當夜英軍放棄比利時境內東段。

citations.quote: CHAPTER XV THE DEFENCE OF THE BRIDGEHEAD 30th May and 31st May, 1940
On the 50th Division front between the frontier and Bulscamp, on the 3rd Division front near Furnes, and in the 4th Division sector at Nieuport, the enemy attacked heavily.
During the night the eastern sector of the bridgehead was abandoned

name.zh-Hant: 縮小周界與英軍最後撤離

summary.zh-Hant: 周界縮至法國國界與貝爾格—弗爾訥運河，德軍1日主攻貝爾格與 Hoymille，英軍後衛守至1日午夜後撤往海灘，6月3日凌晨英軍撤離完畢。

citations.quote: CHAPTER XVI LAST DAYS AT DUNKIRK 1st June to 4th June, 1940
when daylight put an end to the night's operations at about three o'clock there were no more British troops to be brought away.
The enemy's main attacks were at Bergues and Hoymille
the existing British front should be held till midnight of the 1st

name.zh-Hant: 法軍後衛與敦克爾克陷落

summary.zh-Hant: 法軍後衛掩護最後兩夜撤退，6月4日上午9時餘部投降，下午2時23分海軍部宣告發電機行動結束，共撤出338,226人。

citations.quote: In fact the remaining French troops surrendered at nine o'clock that morning, June the 4th.
Operation Dynamo was officially ended by an Admiralty message timed 2.23 p.m.
When the operation ended 338,226 had been evacuated
